'''Ni-Ke-Vanz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] who joined [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota's]] [[Kota's squad|squad]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Previously, he had labored as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]] alongside a [[Khommite/Legends|Khommite]] who gave him detailed information on Khommite [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] processes.
